caption: The drawing displays a single, ornate decorative object centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a jewelry piece or a metal ornament, predominantly gold in color with some subtle brown and gray shading for detail. It features a symmetric design with an elaborate, shield-like top that has three outward curves and internal ornamental patterns, including small diamond-shaped elements filled with geometric designs. Beneath this top section is a round central element, which looks like a circular bezel or ring decorated with intricate motifs. Hanging from the bottom of the round element is a set of gold chain-like tassels arranged in a triangular shape, with the central tassel being the longest. The drawing is bordered by a double-line rectangular frame, and the artist’s signature, "M. Bahold," is placed in small text near the bottom right corner of the frame. The rest of the page is blank.
title: Brooch
